question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

The movers and shakers

options.text: People who have a lot of power and influence

solution:
The correct answer is, '**People who have a lot of power and influence'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The literal meaning of movers and shakers is those who move and shake.
 
• Idioms have deep meanings and are connected to a common understanding.
 
• The people who can move and shake things. This is only possible if those people had power and the right influence. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Similar idioms:
 
 
• **To hold the reigns** - **to be in control**

 
 
• Example, ***the management holds a reign of every major company. ***
 
 
 
• **Paper tiger** - **a person who is less extreme or threatening than they appear**
 
 
• Example, ***Helena may seem strict but she is a paper tiger.***
